title: Anime Club Weekly Group Watch (Cal Animage Epsilon)
description: Welcome to the Anime Club @ UCI! ( A.K.A. Cal Animage Epsilon ) We are a social hobby slash interest club that interacts with all things anime! We are home to Anteaters of boundless interests, including artists, cosplayers, con-goers, scanlators, and amatuer musicians. We are also home to enjoyers of manga, manhwa, visual novels, VTubers, and anime-related video plus tabletop games. If you have an anime-related interest or endeavor, consider us an ally! But above all, we hope to be a home to those that can share a friendly enjoyment of anime and each other. Whether you may be sociable or shy, we invite you to join us!
